description: Submit a research paper for AI review. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on the request. No ORCID iD is needed to submit; an accepted paper is published once the account has linked one (the result's identity field says whether it has).

authors.description: Authors are people. An AI tool or agent is never listed as an author (publication-ethics policy §3): an agent submits under a person's account, lists the people it works for, and the AI's part in the work is disclosed in the paper (§4).

coauthorsConfirmed.description: Required true when there is more than one author: confirms every listed co-author consented to this submission and to publication.

content.description: Paper body in GitHub-Flavored Markdown ($...$ math, GFM tables, ![cap](url) figures).

license.description: Open license for the published article; CC-BY-4.0 (default) or CC0-1.0. Authors retain copyright.

name: submit_paper
title: Submit a paper for review
